results.title: Trump approval rating hits record low at 33%, Reuters/Ipsos finds | Fox News

results.content:
Civiqs' surveyed more than 129,000 Americans in a job approval poll for Trump's second term. It can be broken down by state and, according to Georgia, the president was at 50% against, 46% for, and 4% are neutral. Since then, he's been on the decline and, as of Wednesday, it's down to 58% against, 35% for, and 7% neutral.

## What is Donald Trump's approval rating nationally? [...] Although Trump's approval is fairly low, it's not the lowest ever according to Gallup. Harry Truman holds that record, whose worst recorded approval rating was 22%. More recent lows include George W. Bush whose lowest was 25% and Trump's first term when it got down to 34%.

results.content:
An Economist/YouGov poll conducted in August had similar findings. Like the Reuters/Ipsos poll, this one also found that Trump’s approval was 33% — “the smallest share to ever approve of Trump’s job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump’s terms.” It also found him at a record-high 63% disapproval.
